name: Object Space Ray Setup
aliases: Camera Space Transformation for Ray Origin
Object Space Ray Casting — Ray Origin Calculation for Near Plane Quad
definition: A method for constructing ray origin and direction in object/local space rather than world space. This makes the raytraced object move, scale, and rotate with the mesh transform.
summary: Object Space Ray Setup constructs ray origins and directions in a mesh's local coordinate system, ensuring the volume moves rigidly with the object unlike static world-space methods.
